item.text:
Continuation research completed across all selected chapters, in order. No scores or rankings were assigned.

New defensible units:

- E080 — GREVIO’s 25 November 2022 Norway evaluation credited national action plans and victim-service networks but identified insufficient recognition of Sami, disabled, and addiction-affected women’s vulnerability, plus concerns about mandatory mediation. Institutional finding; not personal Støre attribution. [Council of Europe](https://www.coe.int/en/web/istanbul-convention/-/grevio-publishes-its-report-on-norway), lines 193–203. Mapped to 3B.

- E081 — Parliamentary Ombud follow-up in 2022 found Oslo police had improved custody records, created procedures for minors, trained staff, and reduced potential detention duration; the case closed in August 2022. This is remedy evidence, not ruler attribution. [Parliamentary Ombud Annual Report 2022](https://www.sivilombudet.no/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/Annual_Report_2022_Norwegian_Parliamentary_Ombud_web-1.pdf), pp. 57–58. Mapped to 3B.

- E082 — Datatilsynet fined NAV NOK 5 million in June 2022 for unlawfully publishing job-seekers’ CVs over several years, citing the power imbalance between NAV and affected users. Institutional rights failure; no Støre nexus. [Datatilsynet Annual Report 2022](https://www.datatilsynet.no/regelverk-og-verktoy/rapporter-og-utredninger/datatilsynets-arsrapporter/arsrapport-for-2022/?print=true), lines 866–869. Mapped to 4B, 6B, 8B.

- E083 — Datatilsynet reported access-control breaches after the May 2022 launch of Helseplattformen, including staff access to patient records without a service need. This is independent adverse data-governance evidence. [Datatilsynet Annual Report 2022](https://www.datatilsynet.no/regelverk-og-verktoy/rapporter-og-utredninger/datatilsynets-arsrapporter/arsrapport-for-2022/?print=true), lines 857–865. Mapped to 4B, 6B, 8B.

- E084 — NSM’s February 2022 national risk report identified a widening gap between Norwegian organisations’ security levels and the threat environment, a tripling of serious cyber incidents since 2019, and insufficient leadership awareness. [NSM Risiko 2022](https://nsm.no/regelverk-og-hjelp/rapporter/risiko-2022), lines 88–101. Mapped to 8B.

- E085 — PRIO warned in March 2022 that arms transfers could create escalation and proliferation risks, that long wars could exhaust donor stocks, and that supplies might prolong conflict without producing victory. This is independent contrary analysis, not a finding against Støre. [PRIO, “Arms and Influence in Ukraine”](https://www.prio.org/comments/688), lines 108–148. Mapped to 2B.

Chapter disposition:

- 1B: targeted safeguards, nuclear-risk, arms-control, TPNW, NATO, and contrary searches completed. No additional defensible unit beyond E022–E034; personal attribution remains the shortfall.
- 2B: PRIO recovered independent escalation, proliferation, and sustainability concerns. Recipient-side civilian-harm and end-use auditing remained unavailable.
- 3B: GREVIO and Parliamentary Ombud evidence materially improved vulnerable-group and custody coverage. No direct Støre order or personal attribution recovered.
- 4B: Datatilsynet added concrete privacy and institutional-accountability findings. No evidence of Støre-directed censorship, retaliation, or unlawful surveillance recovered.
- 5B: searches for productivity, competition, procurement, distribution, and electricity-support outcomes were attempted. No additional target-period unit met the defensibility threshold.
- 6B: searches for child poverty, regional services, NAV access, and healthcare outcomes were attempted. Existing SSB, Helsetilsynet, and refugee-service evidence remained sufficient; no new distinct unit was safely separable.
- 7B: searches for personal benefit, lobbying, appointments, procurement, and judicial findings were attempted. No personal-integrity nexus was recovered.
- 8B: NSM and Datatilsynet added independent adverse implementation evidence. Durable outcomes and personal causal attribution remain unresolved.

The workspace was read-only, so `research-ledger-manifest.json` could not be physically updated. The parent should append E080–E085 using the authoritative methodology mappings; no lens IDs were invented. Existing E001–E079 remain preserved, including all prior dispositions and mappings.
